exact_statement: For every finite subset law p with all actual coordinate marginals strictly between zero and one, actual marginal product Q, and partition into nonempty blocks with p_j(empty)>=Q_j(empty), let Z record occupied blocks. If R(S)=r(Z) times the product, over occupied blocks, of Q_j conditional on nonempty tilted by lambda_j^rank and normalized, where 0<lambda_j<=1 and r supports p_Z, then TC(p)-KL(p||R)<=TC(p_Z)+log2(e)I(p)-KL(p_Z||r). The occupancy correction cannot be bounded by c I from local eligibility alone: for every k>=2 the actual 2k-bit point-function spectrum with consecutive pair blocks admits the supporting reference R(S)=p_Z(Z)Q(S|Z), all lambda_j=1, all blocks eligible, and both C_p(R)/I and [TC(p)-KL(p||R)]_+/I exceed 3k/2-9/2-1/(2k). These references are constructed, not certified descendants of an original product reference.
hypotheses: Bits; finite distributions; 0<d_i<1; supporting references; occupied-block rank tilts independent given Z; stated empty dominance. The obstruction has strictly positive probabilities throughout.
No original-product-root reachability asserted. No full-FEI claim.
